command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'IDENTITY host=%s user=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$(id -un)"
before_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
before_enter=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
installed=$(sudo -n sha256sum /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'INSTALLED_SHA=%s\n' "$installed"
url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gschaidergabriel/self-integration/2f9fa1004ab140eb312302f799bf2e6165c4aff6/werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py'
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then remote=$(curl -fsSL --max-time 20 "$url" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then remote=$(wget -qO- --timeout=20 "$url" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); else echo 'NO_HTTP_CLIENT=1'; exit 96; fi
printf 'MAIN_087_SHA=%s\n' "$remote"
if [[ "$installed" == "$remote" ]]; then echo 'SOURCE_BIND=BYTE_IDENTICAL'; else echo 'SOURCE_BIND=DRIFT'; fi
after_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
after_enter=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
printf 'SERVICE_BEFORE pid=%s enter=%s\n' "$before_pid" "$before_enter"
printf 'SERVICE_AFTER pid=%s enter=%s\n' "$after_pid" "$after_enter"
[[ "$before_pid" == "$after_pid" && "$before_enter" == "$after_enter" ]] || { echo 'RUNTIME_EPOCH_DRIFT=1' >&2; exit 97; }
